## About
Our Garage is a full-service auto repair shop in Aurora, Colorado, close to Lowry and Fitzsimmons. We work on imports and domestic vehicles, including light trucks and sport utility vehicles.
We are an approved AAA Aurora auto repair shop and are recognized as an ASE Blue Seal of Excellence Facility. Every invoice is itemized, and we explain which repairs fix a problem now and which are preventive maintenance.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating across 91 Google reviews. Call us to set up an appointment.

## Services
- Brakes: Brake diagnosis and repair for import and domestic vehicles.
- Oil changes: Routine oil service to keep your engine running well.
- Tires and wheel alignment: Tire service and alignment for cars and light trucks.
- Timing belt, radiator and air conditioning: Timing belt replacement, radiator work and A/C service.
- Heavy engine and transmission: Major engine service and transmission work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on both imports and domestic cars?
A: Yes. We repair and service imports like Toyota, Honda, Subaru and Kia, and American cars like Chevy, Ford, Jeep and Dodge.

Q: What if my car needs to stay in the shop for a while?
A: For longer services, we offer special rental car rates through Enterprise Rental Cars.

Q: Can I see the parts you replaced?
A: Yes. Replaced parts can be inspected on request, and your itemized invoice identifies any used or remanufactured parts.
